original.statement: cert-manager v1.17 deprecates the ValidateCAA feature gate, which validates the CAA DNS record during ACME issuance; it still works in v1.17 but will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0.

decision.reason: [ev-0d3b308e9192] says "we deprecated the `ValidateCAA` feature gate which will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0". The upgrade guide [ev-09a9c9047035] repeats that it is deprecated and will be removed in v1.18. The upstream section also covers other feature-gate changes, but this question asks only about the ValidateCAA part, which the evidence states directly. So the subject (feature-gate ValidateCAA) and the change type (deprecated, still present in 1.17) are right.
